summary: Visually verified CAPEX Intelligence 'Delivered by us' filter and board CAPEX PDF export as owner@isodemo.com. Logged in, used Switch area → Main app, navigated Reports → CAPEX Intelligence tab (data-testid=capex-intelligence-tab). Supplied bar renders with all 3 buttons and stat: '1 assets delivered by us (7%) · 12-mo replacement forecast £0'. Clicking 'Delivered by us' filters the equipment list to a single supplied asset (Pulse Runner GP — GPDIST-SN-B64580). 'Whole estate' restores the full list. Status filter chips (6 chips: capex-filter-all/replace_now/replace_soon/at_risk/monitor/healthy) compose with source filter without console errors. Board Report (PDF) button downloads capex-board-report-2026-07-23.pdf (14,726 bytes, valid %PDF, HTTP 200) and toast 'Board CAPEX report downloaded' appears. Direct GET /api/capex/board-report.pdf also returns 200 with valid PDF bytes.
